inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Suspicious Process Spawning from Notepad++ Updater

properties.description: This rule looks for the GUP.exe process (the legitimate updater) spawning unexpected child processes like cmd.exe or the known malicious AutoUpdater.exe.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Suspicious Process Spawning from Notepad++ Updater
properties.query:
let suspicious_children = dynamic(["update.exe", "AutoUpdater.exe", "curl.exe", "cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "rundll32.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(12h)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "gup.exe"
| where not(FileName =~ "explorer.exe" or FileName matches regex @"^npp\..*\.Installer.*\.exe$")
| where FileName in~ (suspicious_children) or FolderPath has_any ("\\Temp\\", "\\tmp\\", "AppData\\Local\\")
| project
    Timestamp,
    DeviceName,
    AccountName,
    InitiatingProcessFileName,
    InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
    FileName,
    FolderPath,
    ProcessCommandLine
